calls.title: Onboarding/growth
calls.summary: The team discussed effective onboarding strategies tailored to specific user segments such as engineers, data scientists, and PM/growth marketers, recognizing that startups and large enterprises would be deprioritized. They identified pain points in the current onboarding flow, particularly the complex SDK setup and data source configurations that lead to user drop-off. Proposed improvements include implementing a CLI-based install wizard and auto-provisioning managed warehouse accounts, which aim to simplify initial experiences. Emphasis was placed on the importance of tracking onboarding metrics to enhance user retention and ensure a quick path to meaningful engagement. The team also reviewed competitive offerings from Statsig and PostHog to inform their approach and agreed on clear next steps to redesign the onboarding process.
calls.keywords: onboarding, install wizard, managed warehouse, SDK connection, user segmentation, experimentation platform

calls.title: Onboarding + Growth + Marketing
calls.summary: The discussion revolved around several key topics including the development of a zero-code onboarding flow that utilizes AI for auto-setup, along with CLI prompts guiding users through configurations for various personas such as engineering and data science. Emphasis was placed on improving retention for Pro users, particularly those with five or more accounts, by tracking detailed onboarding metrics and providing manual onboarding support. The complexity of experiment creation and execution was acknowledged, along with plans to enhance the visual editor for marketing purposes. Challenges with upselling Pro to Enterprise users were noted, with an intent to adopt usage-based pricing to address conversion issues. Finally, the importance of tracking user behavior during the onboarding funnel was highlighted to better correlate usage patterns with churn and upgrades.
calls.keywords: onboarding, feature flag, experiment, retention, AI agent, signup flow
